title: llm-usage-metrics blocks report output (v1)
description: Envelope and payload for blocks --json output: estimated 5-hour usage blocks per source, across machines.

data.description: Estimated blocks in the window, and the blocks containing now.

estimated.description: Always true: blocks follow a community convention, not data from the provider.

blockHours.description: Length of a block in hours.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the date window.

since.description: First day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD); null for the full history.

until.description: Last day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD); null when open-ended.

top.description: With --top N (N > 0): the number of blocks asked for and what ranked them; null otherwise.

blockCount.description: Blocks in the window, before the default limit or --top.

blocks.description: Without --top, the 20 most recent blocks in time order; with --top N, the top N by rank; with --top 0, every block in time order.

activeBlocks.description: Blocks containing now, whether or not --top shows them; empty when the window ended before today.

modelBreakdown.description: Usage of one model within the block.

burnRate.description: Usage per hour since the block started (at least one minute), for the block containing now.

remainingMinutes.description: Whole minutes until the block ends, rounded up.

costUsdPerHour.description: Omitted when no event of the block has a cost.

costIncomplete.description: True when the block's cost is incomplete, so the cost rate is a lower bound.

block.description: One estimated block: it starts at the UTC hour of the source's first event at or after the previous block's end and lasts blockHours.

source.description: Source id; one stream per source across machines.

start.description: ISO timestamp of the block start.

end.description: ISO timestamp of the block end (exclusive).

startUncertain.description: True when usage before the days read may have started the chain earlier, so the start may differ.

firstEventAt.description: ISO timestamp of the block's first event.

lastEventAt.description: ISO timestamp of the block's last event.

models.description: Models used in the block, most tokens first.

active.description: The burn rate when the block contains now; null otherwise.
